title: Príncipe Real — 3-bedroom garden apartment with Tagus views
description: A rare garden-floor apartment on Rua Dom Pedro V, steps from Praça do Príncipe Real. Fully renovated in 2023 with oak flooring, a Bulthaup kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private 42 m² terrace. The building dates from 1912 with a restored façade; inside, three double bedrooms (one en-suite), two bathrooms and a separate laundry. Ideal as a primary residence or high-yield short-let in one of Lisbon's most sought-after districts. Annual IMI approx. €2,400. Energy certificate B-.
address: 84 Rua Dom Pedro V, Príncipe Real, 1250-142 Lisbon

title: Ribeira townhouse — 4-bed riverside home, UNESCO quarter
description: Characterful four-bedroom townhouse on Rua de São João, 200 m from the Douro waterfront. Spread over four floors with a rooftop terrace overlooking the Dom Luís I bridge. Original granite walls, chestnut beams and a contemporary extension (2021) housing the kitchen and master suite. Two living rooms, a wine cellar and a single garage space included. Strong long-let demand from expat families; short-let licence transferable. Freehold, no condominium fees.
address: 17 Rua de São João, Ribeira, 4050-553 Porto

title: Ruzafa — Loft apartment with private terrace, Valencia
description: Industrial loft conversion on Calle de Cuba in the heart of Ruzafa — Valencia's creative district. Open-plan 98 m² living space with 3.2 m ceilings, exposed brick and a mezzanine home office. South-facing terrace (18 m²) with outdoor kitchen. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, ducted A/C and underfloor heating. Building has lift and bicycle storage. Walking distance to Mercado de Colón and Turia gardens. Current tenant until September 2026 at €1,450/month.

title: Le Marais — Haussmannian 2-bed near Place des Vosges
description: Elegant second-floor apartment in a 1870 limestone building on Rue des Archives. Original herringbone parquet, marble fireplaces and 3.1 m ceiling height. Two bedrooms (12 m² and 14 m²), a galley kitchen upgraded with Miele appliances, and a combined living/dining room of 32 m². Cellar included. Charges de copropriété €420/month. Stone's throw from Place des Vosges, Musée Picasso and Saint-Paul Métro (Line 1). Ideal pied-à-terre or long-let to corporate tenants.
address: 28 Rue des Archives, Le Marais, 75004 Paris

title: Kensington — Victorian 2-bed flat, Cromwell Road
description: Bright two-bedroom flat on the second floor of a red-brick Victorian mansion block on Cromwell Road. 72 m² with a west-facing reception room, separate kitchen, master bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a second double bedroom. Share of freehold; annual service charge £3,200. Zone 1 transport — Gloucester Road and Earl's Court within 8 minutes' walk. EPC rating C. Chain-free sale; vacant possession available.

title: Dubai Marina — 2-bed with full marina view, Marina Walk
description: Fully furnished two-bedroom apartment in a premium tower on Marina Walk with unobstructed marina and yacht-club views. 1,285 sq ft, open kitchen with Bosch appliances, floor-to-ceiling glazing and a 90 sq ft balcony. Building amenities: infinity pool, gym, concierge and covered parking (1 bay). Tenanted until March 2027 at AED 145,000/year — 5.1% gross yield. Service charge AED 18/sq ft. Freehold for all nationalities.

title: Brera — Design-led 2-bed near Pinacoteca di Brera
description: Architect-renovated apartment on Via Brera, 150 m from the Pinacoteca. 105 m² with a 28 m² living room, designer kitchen (Boffi), two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Air conditioning, alarm system and video entry. Condominium fees €180/month. A-rated energy certificate. Strong demand from Milan's fashion and finance professionals; ideal furnished long-let at €3,200/month. No agent commission for direct buyers.

title: Pedregalejo — Beachfront villa with pool, Málaga
description: Detached four-bedroom villa 80 m from Pedregalejo beach on the eastern Costa del Sol. 280 m² built on a 520 m² plot with infinity pool, outdoor dining pergola and a separate guest studio. Panoramic sea views from the upper terrace. Renovated 2022: solar panels, heat pump and smart-home lighting. Double garage and gated entrance. Licenced holiday rental — 2025 gross income €68,000. IBI €1,850/year.

title: Presqu'île — Lyon 3-bed with Rhône views
description: Spacious third-floor apartment overlooking the Rhône on Quai Rambaud. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a 38 m² living room with balcony. Recently insulated façade (2024), double glazing and individual gas heating. Underground parking space included. Five minutes to Place Bellecour and Part-Dieu TGV. Rental estimate €2,100/month unfurnished. Copropriété charges €310/month.

title: Vilamoura — Pool villa, marina lifestyle, Algarve
description: Contemporary four-bedroom villa in a gated community 400 m from Vilamoura Marina. 320 m² living space on a 1,100 m² plot with heated pool, landscaped gardens and outdoor kitchen. Open-plan ground floor, cinema room and a master suite with dressing room. Golf course views; five championship courses within 15 minutes. Ideal lock-and-leave second home with strong summer rental demand. Annual condominium €2,400.
